grammar_focus: 间接引语(主考:say/tell + that + 从句 · say 不接人 tell 接人 · 时态后移 am→was/will→would/can→could/have done→had done · 人称变化 · 转述疑问 asked if/whether)+ 宾语从句 that可省/if vs whether(辅考讲深)+ 过去将来时 would/should(辅考讲深)
scene: 被老板叫进办公室 · 紧张以为要被裁员 · 老板说生意差、公司付不起工资、已裁二十人 · 正准备挨刀时却反被告知加薪一千

grammar_card.title: 转述别人的话(间接引语)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲怎么把别人说的话'转述'出来——间接引语。转述过去说过的话时,从句里的时态要往过去'退一步'。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 间接引语:say / tell + that + 从句(that 常可省)
He said that business was bad.
say 后不接人;tell 后必须接人
He said that… / He told me that…
转述过去说的话,从句时态往过去退:am→was, do→did
'I am busy.' → He said that he was busy.
'I will see you.' → She said she would see me.
'I broke it.' → He said that he had broken it.

specialRules.rule: 转述一般疑问句用 ask if/whether + 陈述语序(不再倒装、不加问号)
从过去看将来,will 变 would(过去将来时);would 通用于各人称

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What was the good news?
options: The writer would get a raise, not get fired

passage: The secretary told me that Mr. Harrison would see me right away. I felt very nervous as I took the elevator up to his office. He did not even look up from his desk when I walked in. After I had sat down, he said that business was very bad. He told me that the firm could not afford to pay such high salaries. Twenty people had already been let go, and I knew that my turn had come. "Mr. Harrison," I said in a weak voice, "may I say something?" "Don't interrupt me," he said sharply. Then he suddenly smiled and told me that I would get a raise. He said I would receive an extra thousand dollars a year. It was the best news I had heard all year!

grammar_points.name: 间接引语——构成 say/tell + that + 从句
间接引语——say 不接人 / tell 接人
间接引语——时态后移(am→was/will→would/can→could/have done→had done)
间接引语——转述陈述句(直接→间接改写)
宾语从句 that 可省 / if vs whether——辅考讲深
过去将来时 would/should(will→would 后移)——辅考讲深
间接引语——人称变化(I→he, my→his)
间接引语——转述疑问(asked if/whether + 陈述语序)

stage5.stem: 间接引语是用来做什么的?
间接引语常用哪个结构?
"He said ___ business was bad."(引出转述的内容)
关于 say 和 tell,正确的是:
options: say 后不接人,tell 后必须接人
say 后必须接人,tell 后不接人

stage5.stem: "他告诉我他很忙"用哪个动词?

stage5.stem: 转述过去说的话,从句里的时态要怎么变?
"'I am busy,' he said." 改成间接引语:
options: He said that he was busy.
He said that he is busy.
He said that he will busy.
He said that he be busy.

stage5.stem: "'I will see you,' she said." 里的 will 转述时变成:
"'I broke the plate,' he said." 改成间接引语(broke 往过去退一步):
options: He said that he had broken the plate.
He said that he broke the plate now.
He said that he breaks the plate.
He said that he will break the plate.

stage5.stem: "'I have just finished,' he said." 改成间接引语(have done 往过去退):
options: He said that he had just finished.
He said that he has just finished.
He said that he will just finish.
He said that he just finish.

stage5.stem: "I don't know ___ he will come."(表示'是否',后面无 or not)
"I don't know ___ or not he comes."(紧跟 or not,只能用):
stage5.stem_cn: 我不知道他到底来不来。

stage5.stem: "He said he ___ go to the north for vacation."(从过去看将来,过去将来时)
"'I broke my cup,' Tom said." 转述时 I 和 my 变成:
转述一般疑问句 "'Are you busy?' he asked." 用:
options: He asked if I was busy.
He asked that I was busy.
He asked if was I busy?

stage5.stem: 转述疑问句时,从句要用什么语序?
options: 陈述语序(主语在前,不倒装,不加问号)
疑问语序(把 be/助动词提前)

stage5.stem: "'You can go now,' the teacher said." 转述(时态和人称都要变):
options: The teacher said that I could go then.
The teacher said that you can go now.
The teacher said that I can go now.
The teacher said that you could went.
